basic_info.description: Step into this charming Bernal Heights home nestled on a quiet one-way street just steps from all the best that Cortland Avenue has to offer. The main floor features a formal entry foyer, dining room, and living room featuring parquet flooring, built-in cabinetry, decorative bay windows, exquisite light fixtures, and ornate mantle among other period details. The skylit kitchen, which features a vintage stove & icebox, adjoins a breakfast room with a set back view of Cortland. Two spacious bedrooms and a classic bathroom with a shower over tub complete this level. Downstairs includes an expansive two car garage with laundry area, built-in storage, separate street entrance, and plenty of room to expand within the footprint. The private backyard awaits your green thumb. This property is a rare opportunity to create your dream home in one of the city's most desirable areas.
